text_block_list.text:
The Trainer paid close attention not to 
overlook any abnormality, as she wasn't 
good at expressing herself. And then, the 
Trainer noticed something.

Perhaps the reason Neo Universe failed in 
another universe was her weakness of 
"difficulty communicating."

Even so, the two of them continued to 
"communicate." Bit by bit, they grew 
closer to each other. Now, the Trainer can 
truly feel her will.

And so, the two communicated meticulously 
time and time again. As a result, they 
were able to notice even the slightest 
off-condition. They devoted themselves 
wholeheartedly to continuing these days.
